D.Wij accepteren je verzoek en controleren: We'll accept your request and check that everything is set up correctly. Then we get to work for you.
D.Of mail naar [info@achieve.nl](~mail). O: Or email [info@achieve.nl](~mail). On working days we'll get back to you within 4 hours.
D.Met deze stappen zet je alles klaar om o: With these steps you set everything up to advertise on TikTok, and give Achieve secure access. You don't share any passwords and you stay the owner of everything.
D.Daarmee log je in op het Business Center: You use it to log in to the Business Center. Don't have one yet? You'll create it in step 1 with your business email address.
D.Op je telefoon, ingelogd in de TikTok-ap: On your phone, logged in to the TikTok app. You'll use it to scan a QR code in step 3.
D.Bedrijfsnaam zoals op je facturen, en ev: Business name as on your invoices, and possibly your company registration number. TikTok may ask for it for the ad account.
D.Bijvoorbeeld een creditcard of PayPal. T: For example a credit card or PayPal. TikTok charges the ad costs to it directly.
D.Alles gebeurt op [business.tiktok.com](~: Everything happens on [business.tiktok.com](~bc) (TikTok Business Center). Each step has a button that opens the Business Center in a new tab. Tick off a step when it's done; this page remembers where you are.
D.Heb je meer dan één Business Center? Kie: Do you have more than one Business Center? Then first pick your business's Business Center. Do the steps on your computer; only the QR code in step 3 is scanned with your phone.
D.Het Business Center is de centrale plek: The Business Center is the central place where your TikTok account, ad account and pixel come together, and where you decide who has access.
D.Heb je al een Business Center? Ga naar s: Already have a Business Center? Go to step 2.
D.Ga naar [business.tiktok.com](bc) en log: Go to [business.tiktok.com](bc) and log in with your TikTok for Business account. No account yet? Click **Sign up** and create one with your business email address.
D.Klik op **Create** (Business Center make: Click **Create** (create a Business Center) and enter your business name as it appears on your invoices.
Choose time zone **Amsterdam** and confirm. You're now automatically the administrator (Admin).
D.**Tip:** zet tweestapsverificatie aan en: **Tip:** turn on two-factor authentication and add a second admin from your own business. That way you can always get in, even if one account stops working.
D.Hier draaien je campagnes en hier betaal: This is where your campaigns run and where you pay for the ads. The account is in your name.
D.Adverteer je al op TikTok? Kies bij punt: Already advertising on TikTok? Then at point 3 choose **Transfer** to move your existing account into your Business Center.
D.Klik in het menu links op **Accounts** e: In the menu on the left, click **Accounts** and choose **Advertiser accounts**.
D.Vul de naam van je bedrijf in, kies land: Enter your business name, choose country **Netherlands**, time zone **Amsterdam** and currency **Euro (EUR)**, and confirm.
D.Open het advertentieaccount en voeg onde: Open the ad account and add a payment method under **Payment**.
D.Land, tijdzone en valuta kun je later **: You **can't change** the country, time zone and currency later. Check them carefully before you confirm.
D.Zo verschijnen je advertenties met de na: This way your ads appear with the name and profile picture of your own TikTok account, and we can use existing videos as ads.
D.Klik in het menu links op **Accounts** e: In the menu on the left, click **Accounts** and choose **TikTok accounts**.
D.Klik op **Add a TikTok account** en kies: Click **Add a TikTok account** and choose **Link an existing TikTok account**.
D.Kies **Send a QR code** en klik op **Nex: Choose **Send a QR code** and click **Next**.
D.Scan de QR-code met de TikTok-app op je: Scan the QR code with the TikTok app on your phone, logged in to your business's account, and approve the request.
D.Nog geen TikTok-account voor je bedrijf?: No TikTok account for your business yet? Create one in the TikTok app first, then come back to this step.
D.De laatste stap. Je koppelt ons Business: The last step. You connect our Business Center to your account, without sharing any passwords. You can always revoke the access.
D.Klik in het menu links op **Partners** (: In the menu on the left, click **Partners** (sometimes under **Users**) and click **Add partner**.
D.Vul ons Business Center-ID in: {ID} en k: Enter our Business Center ID: {ID} and click **Next**.
D.TikTok vraagt of dit bureau je advertent: TikTok asks whether this agency manages your ads. Choose **Yes**.
D.Kies je **advertentieaccount** en geef h: Choose your **ad account** and give it the role **Admin**. Also choose your **TikTok account**.
D.Je geeft ons alleen toegang tot deze ond: You only give us access to these items, not to your whole Business Center. If something is named slightly differently for you, look in the menu on the left.
D.Blijf ik eigenaar van mijn TikTok-accoun: Do I stay the owner of my TikTok account and ad account?
D.Ja. Alles staat in jouw Business Center: Yes. Everything is in your Business Center and in your name. We only get access to work for you. If you want to stop, remove us via Partners in your Business Center.
D.Moet ik mijn wachtwoord met jullie delen: Do I have to share my password with you?
D.Nee, nooit. Juist daarom werkt het via e: No, never. That's exactly why it works through a partner connection: we log in with our own accounts. If anyone asks for your password on our behalf, contact us.
D.Die hoef je niet zelf aan te maken. Wij: You don't need to create it yourself. We create it in your ad account, so it stays yours, and set it up on your website together with you.
D.Dan ben je waarschijnlijk geen beheerder: Then you're probably not an administrator (Admin) of the Business Center. Ask the person who manages it to do step 4, or to make you an administrator.
D.Mijn advertentieaccount staat al bij een: My ad account is already in another Business Center, for example from a previous agency.
D.Een advertentieaccount kan maar in één B: An ad account can only be in one Business Center. Ask the previous agency to release the account, so you can move it into your own Business Center with Transfer. If that doesn't work, let us know; we'll work out the best route together.
D.De advertentiekosten betaal je rechtstre: You pay the ad costs directly to TikTok, through the payment method in your ad account. That way you always see exactly what's being spent.
D.Geef Achieve toegang tot TikTok | Achiev: Give Achieve access to TikTok | Achieve
